recipes.name: Ranch Roasted Potato Wedges
instructions: Line two baking trays and preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*.
Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise, then cut into wedges about ½ inch (1 cm) thick. Transfer to a large bowl.
Add all the remaining ingredients and toss to coat.
Spread the potatoes out over the baking trays.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until golden. Give the potatoes a flip once at the halfway point. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat in the oven to retain crispiness.
